register_findings.repeat_initialize: When initialization count is nonzero, set then clear bit16 of fff55108 with150 delay units between writes.
register_findings.no_link_initialize: Set fff54008 bit1 and controller+28=1, then request idle clock level.
register_findings.debounce: Start previous=false,count=0. Equal samples increment count; accept at100. First rising sample changes previous to true and resets count. Falling sample after rising disconnects immediately. Delay10 scheduler ticks between samples.
register_findings.connected_reset: If controller+28==1, set fff55108 bit16, perform20 delays of250 units, clear bit16 under canonical Power nested interrupt lock, clear controller+28.
register_findings.pending_acknowledgement: Read three halfwords atfff5402c/30/34 and write their complements atfff54054/58/5c. NONMATCHING draft's shifted combination is not used.
register_findings.connected_programming: Restore three halfword masks atfff54040/44/48; wordfff5512c=81810303; wordfff55114=101; delay1; separate halfword read-modify-writes setfff54004 bits2 then3; halfwordsfff54068=010d,6c=2083,70=0,80=0fff; register actual IRQ; setfff54090 bits1,2 only after registration succeeds.
register_findings.session_reset_preservation: Reset bytes+4,+5,+20,+21 and words+8,+12,+16. Preserve mode word+0 and reserved bytes+6,+7,+22,+23.

canonical_dependencies.resource_route: xm1_power_resource_route_request(0x70b,30,11 or0), canonical Power resource_route.rs implementing6499d0/64a0bc/64a224; stock ignores request status. Constructor completion and mapped route RAM/source table/clock MMIO are mandatory preconditions.
canonical_dependencies.resource_registry_distinction: 6499d0 is a route vote, not resource_registry acquire/release. DriverHandle and RegistryHandle remain distinct.
canonical_dependencies.controller_irq: 64e918 source15 maps via image4 table entry7c91d8 to line84, priority13, mode1. Uses transport::cpu::IrqContext handles/sequence/sources and transport::irq_control configure/enable, not a parallel registry. Physical handler is supplied as typed irq_control::Handler.
canonical_dependencies.irq_release: transport::cpu::release_interrupt_handle implements the retained software handle/IRQ teardown used by finalize.
canonical_dependencies.delay: transport::cpu::spin_delay with DelayCounter physical timer boundary; full start uses transport::scheduler::delay and the shared retained scheduler Machine/domain.
canonical_dependencies.dma: TransferBuffer owns or maps actual PublishedAperture storage. Channel allocation, arm, DMA receive programming, cache operations, stop and teardown remain transport::cpu::open_channel/ChannelRuntime and transport::DmaChannel/ControllerTeardown. These roots contain no buffer allocator call; none is invented.

integration_contract.module: Expose transport_start_cpu as a sibling of transport in vendor_protocol lib.rs; include all three new files in the existing build graph.
integration_contract.irq_test_constructor: Parent-owned transport_cpu::PublishedInterruptHandlers::from_handlers(zero:Handler,one:Handler)->Self exposes typed guest handler publication for host fixtures.
integration_contract.memory: UsbMemory::owned accepts an exclusive204-byte host aperture; unsafe UsbMemory::native maps0146975c..01469828. All mutations access backing bytes, not a detached shadow model. TransferBuffer::owned/native reuse retained PublishedAperture.
integration_contract.start_runtime: StartRuntime holds io:I,irq:&mut transport::cpu::IrqContext<B>,timer:T,handler:irq_control::Handler. MappedUsbIo is a concrete volatile MMIO provider. Generic StartIo/Backend/DelayCounter seams represent physical registers, IRQ instructions and timer counters only.
integration_contract.connection_vote: transport_start_cpu::vote_connection(io:&mut impl StartIo,connected:bool)->transport::ServiceStatus calls StartIo::request_clock; MappedUsbIo forwards to the canonical Power route provider with selector70b, slot30, level11 or0. Controller owner uses it for actual d814f4 publication.
integration_contract.status_queries: link_connected(io:&mut impl StartIo)->bool reads fff55104 bit31. bus_status_bit14(io:&mut impl StartIo)->bool reads fff5409c halfword bit14 only when connected.
integration_contract.synchronous_start: UsbStart::start(runtime,machine,transport::scheduler::layout::Domain) executes begin/debounce/register programming with actual shared scheduler delay. Returns Ready or Disconnected; poll_start is also available for an owned scheduler continuation.
integration_contract.disconnected_join: Controller owner must consume StartProgress::Disconnected using its concrete d814f4(0) body: update controller1469cd0+3c0; on bit0 change clear+3d0, request idle route vote, and publish queue36 event340a. This publication is not a physical callback and is not waived as environment work.
integration_contract.session_join: Connection owner calls reset_session/set_session(SessionMode::from_abi(raw))/clear_active directly. Parent owns existing Service and operation-table bridges.
integration_contract.shutdown_join: Pass controller_irq() and retained channel leases to ControllerTeardown. No new transport stop implementation is introduced.

source_tests: Session reset preserves mode, reserved bytes and unrelated USB state
Callback publication writes guest address and actual register masks
Disconnected and falling-link paths do not enable IRQ or endpoints
Stable link produces required halfword/word register values and canonical IRQ84 registration
Clear-active plus finalize replaces the actual IRQ lease and republishes masks
Bus status bit14 is gated by the connected link bit
Host-owned transfer bytes are read by retained EndpointTransfer FIFO programming
